title: breynia spatulifolia
intro: Breynia spatulifolia, commonly known as Spatulate breynia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Phyllanthaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, particularly in the treatment of various diseases, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Breynia spatulifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
